context.title: Bedingte und gemeinsame Wahrscheinlichkeiten im Kontext unterscheiden

context.titleEn: Distinguish conditional and joint probabilities in context
context.descriptionEn: The learner can distinguish between P(B|A), P(A|B), and P(A∩B) in contextual settings and move from one representation to another using tree diagrams or contingency tables.
